title: Preparation of Binding Buffer (BB)
author: Nicola O'Reilly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfd2ji8e
materials: Please select between the recipes for 2 L + 80 ml Binding buffer BB, 4 L + 160 ml Binding buffer BB and 5 L + 200 ml Binding buffer BB.

steps.title: Prepare 2 L Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 L batch of Binding Buffer (BB) using the following components and conditions.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 955.2 g GuHCl into a 2 L beaker.
Add 500 mL freshly drawn milliQ water; stir and heat to 60 °C to dissolve.
Add 80 mL 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).
Add 1 mL Tween-20 and stir well to mix.
Make up to 2 L with Isopropanol (approximately 800 mL) using a 1 L graduated cylinder.
Label with batch and date.
Store in a flammables cupboard at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare 4 L Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 4 L batch of Binding Buffer (BB) using the following components and conditions.

substeps.instruction: Add 1000 mL freshly drawn milliQ water to a 5 L beaker.
Weigh 1.911 kg GuHCl in aliquots using a 3 L beaker and carefully add to the 5 L beaker.
Stir (a sterile pipette may be required) and heat to 60 °C to dissolve.
Make up to 4 L with Isopropanol (approximately 1600 mL) using a 1 L graduated cylinder, transferring the buffer to a second 5 L beaker.
Add 160 mL 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).
Add 2 mL Tween-20 and stir well to mix.
Label with batch and date.
Store in a flammables cupboard at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare 5 L Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5 L batch of Binding Buffer (BB) using the following components and conditions.

substeps.instruction: Add 1250 mL freshly drawn milliQ water to a 5 L beaker.
Weigh 2.388 kg GuHCl in aliquots using a 3 L beaker and carefully add to the 5 L beaker.
Stir (a sterile pipette may be required) and heat to 60 °C to dissolve.
Make up to 5 L with Isopropanol (approximately 2 L) using a 1 L graduated cylinder, transferring the buffer to a second 5 L beaker.
Add 200 mL 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).
Add 2.5 mL Tween-20 and stir well to mix.
Label with batch and date.
Store in a flammables cupboard at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).
